I am a Professor of Economics at the [Université du Québec à Montréal](https://economie.esg.uqam.ca/?lang=en).
My research is in macroeconomics and econometrics, with a particular focus on the
identification of structural VARs and on understanding cyclical fluctuations.

Recent work looks at identification through higher-order moments and at
spectral methods for non-Gaussian SVARs. You can find current projects on the
[working papers](working-papers.qmd) page.
